purpose: Non-secret external prerequisites for implementation and later stage acceptance. No credentials or paid calls are stored here.
m0Decision: All external boundaries have one accountable adapter/domain owner. Account, budget and commercial inputs are deliberately deferred to the gate that requires them; their absence does not authorize a substitute live claim.
recordingRules: Use separate local, sandbox/test-mode and live environment identifiers in every later acceptance record.
Record non-secret account identity, region, entitlement and capped budget only; never store keys, webhook secrets, signed URLs or payment details.
A missing input blocks its dependent gate and preserves the disabled or deterministic fixture path where the specification allows one.
